verse.verse_1: Glorify the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verse.verse_2: who created all things and gave them due proportions,
verse.verse_3: who determines the nature [of all that exists], and guided it accordingly;
verse.verse_5: then turns it into black stubble.
verse.verse_6: [O Prophet!] We shall make you recite the Quran so that you will not forget any of it --
verse.verse_7: except whatever God wills; He knows both what is manifest and what is hidden --
verse.verse_8: We shall facilitate for you the Easy Way.
verse.verse_9: Remind, if the reminder can be of benefit.
verse.verse_10: He who fears [God] will heed the reminder,
verse.verse_11: but it will be ignored by the most unfortunate,
verse.verse_12: who will enter the Great Fire,
verse.verse_13: where he will neither die nor live.
verse.verse_15: who remembers the name of his Lord and prays, shall indeed be successful.
verse.verse_16: But you prefer the life of this world,
verse.verse_17: although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
verse.verse_18: This indeed is what is taught in the former scriptures --
verse.verse_19: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
